title: 3.3.8c Lab — Method that returns data
description: Add an isAbove(y) method to Planet that returns true when this.shape.position.y is above the given threshold.

steps.title: Add isAbove(y) to Planet
steps.instructions: Inside the Planet class, write a method `isAbove(threshold)` that returns `this.shape.position.y > threshold`.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and look up the position property.

requirements.title: isAbove() returns a boolean comparison
requirements.description: Write isAbove(threshold) inside Planet. It must return this.shape.position.y > threshold.
